content.comment_body: Hello everyone. When I attempt to transfer a [product_name] web project to a [product_name] device over Ethernet, I receive an error similar to the one shown in the screenshot. How can this be resolved? If I download it to the microSD card, everything works fine. Additionally, programs from [product_name] software are successfully downloaded to the device, so this issue only occurs with the web editor on Windows 10.
I resolved the issue by updating Java and installing the 32-bit version of the [product_name] web editor software instead of the 64-bit.

analysis.insight_summary: A user had trouble transferring projects from the [product_name] web editor directly to a [product_name] device over Ethernet, receiving an error. The same transfer to microSD succeeded, suggesting the problem related specifically to the Ethernet download process, and not the content or hardware. The issue was exclusive to working with the [product_name] web editor on Windows 10, and was fixed by switching to the software's 32-bit version and updating Java.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects projects created with the [product_name] web editor to transfer successfully to [product_name] devices via Ethernet on Windows 10, just as other [product_name] software functions correctly.
